prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving forward along a sandy path bordered by large reddish-brown rocks and sparse greenery under a clear blue sky. As the camera advances, it pans slightly to reveal more of the rocky terrain and dense clusters of trees and shrubs, indicating a transition from the beach into a forested area. The movement continues through the forest, where the camera angle shifts to capture the intricate details of the tree trunks and the dappled sunlight filtering through the leaves, casting dynamic shadows on the ground. The path becomes narrower and more rugged, with scattered stones and patches of grass. As the viewer progresses, the camera tilts upward, revealing a breathtaking view of the ocean in the distance, framed by towering red rock formations. The scene transitions back to the rocky landscape, with the camera panning around to showcase the expansive natural beauty of Castle Rock Beach, Meelup, Australia, under the bright, sunny conditions of daytime. The entire sequence captures the serene and untouched environment, emphasizing the vivid colors of the red rocks, lush green foliage, and the deep blue sky, all while maintaining an empty and tranquil atmosphere.
